messages:
incident_bot: 📣 ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway (prod, us-west-2). Error rate: 8% -> 22% over last 3m. Auto-page to #incidents and oncall.

jess_oncall: i'm on it. seeing spike on graphs. paging support + infra.

miguel_sre: oncall, what metric exactly? 5xx from upstream or from our gateway?

jess_oncall: dashboards show gateway 502/503s increasing. upstream model hosts returning 504s intermittently. latency also up. looks like retry amplification on LB.

anya_infra: grabbing envoy / lb logs now. i see repeated retries to same backend and circuit-breaker flips. probable route weight change earlier this morning.

lee_support: FYI a few customers have emailed about timeouts. not widespread yet but at least one paying account reported degraded inference. adding to incident notes.

tom_ops: putting traffic to fallback pool (model-variant-b) as quick mitigation. patching route weights to reduce pressure on hot hosts.

jess_oncall: do it. steps?

tom_ops: running quickpatch:

```bash
# reduce weight for pool 'hot-inference'
curl -X POST https://infra-api.local/routes/weights -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","weights":{"hot-inference":0.2,"fallback":0.8}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

miguel_sre: also recommend lowering envoy retry policy to avoid amplification. current config retries: 3 for x-x errors. change to 0 for 502/503 and keep 1 for idempotent paths.

anya_infra: preparing envoy rollback snippet. applying patch to disable internal retries on gateway route:

```yaml
# envoy route patch
retry_policy:
  retry_on: ""
  num_retries: 0
```

jess_oncall: applying now. patch deployed to prod edge; rolling to 50% then 100%.

incident_bot: Deploy: envoy/retry-config @prod-edge started by jess_oncall (runbook: reduce-retries). status: in_progress.

lee_support: adding customer impact note: 12 requests/min failing for a handful of customers, possible SLA impact. opened ticket INC-4621.

tom_ops: traffic shift done. fallback pool handling 78% of requests now. error rate dropped to ~6%.

miguel_sre: circuit breakers were tripping because many retries were inflating concurrent streams per host. with retries off the cb counters drop. we should adjust cb thresholds after stable.

anya_infra: confirming logs: decreased 5xx from 22% -> 6% in 6m. backend latencies still slightly elevated but within tolerance.

jess_oncall: good. i'm going to notify paging flow closure in 15m if stable. handoff: i'm handing to miguel for postmortem and config follow-up.

miguel_sre: taking handoff. next steps: 1) run host capacity check and evict any noisy tasks 2) review rollout from this morning that increased weight to hot pool 3) propose safer retry policy and cb tuning 4) run a canary test for new LB policy

lee_support: i'll follow up with affected customers and patch the support tickets with mitigation notes.

incident_bot: Incident update: mitigation applied (traffic shift + retries disabled). Current error rate: 5.8%. On-call: miguel_sre assigned for follow-up. Incident will be P1 -> P2 if stable for 30m.

jess_oncall: thumbs for quick actions :thumbsup:. adding timeline to incident doc.

tom_ops: saved the route change diff to infra-config repo (commit 0a1b2c). will open PR for long-term change.

miguel_sre: creating postmortem ticket PM-987. need logs around 02:10–02:30 UTC; please tag relevant traces.

anya_infra: will attach envoy logs and ALB access logs to PM-987.

lee_support: update: customer A confirmed improved latency after fallback. closing their urgent ticket.

miguel_sre: thanks. will run through root cause analysis: early hypothesis = weight ramp for hot pool + aggressive retry policy -> retry storm -> cb thrash -> cascading 5xx. will include remediation: safer rollout automation, retry policy defaults, CB hysteresis.

jess_oncall: leaving now. miguel you're the owner. ping me if anything regresses. closing paging in 30.

incident_bot: Paging: oncall handoff completed. new owner: miguel_sre. Incident status: investigating -> mitigated (monitoring)."
